scripts.test:e2e:web: npm run build && npx playwright test
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/visual-aesthetic.e2e.spec.ts --project=android-webview
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:aab: bash scripts/release-gate.sh android && cd android && export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 && ./gradlew bundleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/debug/app-debug.aab ../build-artifacts/BlockBlastStar.aab
scripts.release: bash scripts/release-gate.sh all && cd android && export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 && ./gradlew assembleDebug bundleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../build-artifacts/BlockBlastStar.apk && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/debug/app-debug.aab ../build-artifacts/BlockBlastStar.aab
